profile.visual_desc: Winged humanoid in heavy blue plate armor with a red loincloth. Large dark bat-like wings extend from the back. Pointed blue helmet covers the head.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Sharp blue armored helmet with a bird-like visor. A narrow horizontal eye slit shows a cold, focused expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Large silver broadsword held with both hands during the initial windup.
profile.step1_ready: Isometric view facing down-right. Warrior stands with wings spread, holding the sword overhead with both hands.
profile.step2_windup: Crouches and pulls the sword further back behind the head. Wings expand to the sides to build momentum.
profile.step3_impact: Swings downward. A large, bright golden crescent energy arc flashes from the upper-right to the lower-left.
profile.step4_finish: Arm extends down at the end of the swing. The golden trail fades while the warrior resets to a standing pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 must align with the downward diagonal trajectory of the sword swing from top-right to bottom-left.
